title: Knockback reducer

replies.author: _Nathy
replies.body:
In your previous appeal you stated this:

"I do not use anything that reduces the knockback me and never use it."

Yet now you're telling me you do use something to reduce your knockback. Why didn't you say this in your earlier appeal? Why did you lie?

The settings of you DNS quite clearly were designed to reduce knockback, not just to better ping.

That being said, there isn't actually a rule on our rules page to give clarity in this area. I'll be making sure that the rules are revised to be more clear on this in the future.

I can also see you are an Overcast player and therefore must be quite upset the server is closing soon. 

Due to the fact that a) Overcast is closing, b) you have waited 2 and a half months and c) this not being explicitly stated in our rules, I am going to have you appealed on the day Overcast closes, so you will have another server to play on when OCN shuts down.

Regards, Nathy
